description: This file declares functions and includes headers related to V4L2 (Video4Linux2) device handling, specifically for initializing devices, calculating frame sizes, and reading raw frame data. It is part of a video streaming or processing module within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.
external_methods: Result<SharedFD> V4l2InitDevice(const std::string&, int, int, int)

methods.name: V4l2InitDevice
methods.description: Initializes a V4L2 device at the specified device path with given format, width, and height, returning a shared file descriptor.

methods.name: V4l2GetBPP
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per pixel for the specified format, used for frame size calculations.

methods.name: V4l2GetFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size in bytes of a single frame for the given format, width, and height.

methods.name: V4l2GetLineWidth
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a single line of video frame data for the specified format and width.

methods.name: V4l2PrintFormat
methods.description: Outputs debug information about the given v4l2_format structure.

methods.name: V4l2StreamFile
methods.description: Optional method used for debugging/testing V4L2 devices, streams data from a file.

methods.name: V4l2ReadRawFile
methods.description: Reads raw frame data in BGRA32 format from a specified file.
